title: Quản trị — Người dùng
prompt: Design admin user directory and selected account detail: search/filter, status, invite/create, disable/reactivate, credential reset, role/grant summary and safe confirmation states. Do not display private SOS or donor case records by default. Vietnamese responsive web and same calm operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Quản trị — Tổ chức và thành viên
prompt: Design organization management and membership page: organization list/profile, active members, membership state, leader relationships, grant entry points and clear scoped permissions. Avoid implying a role name alone grants all regional access. Vietnamese responsive web and operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Quản trị — Phân quyền và khu vực

Explicitly show effective scope and prevent accidental overgranting. Vietnamese responsive web, operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.
